prompt: How do we lawfully transfer personal data from Brazil to our US parent company?
assertions: States the governing instrument: ANPD Resolution 19/2024 (the international transfer regulation)
Lists the mechanisms: adequacy decisions (none issued to date), ANPD standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, specific guarantees
States the SCC deadline reality: the 12-month grace period ended August 23, 2025 — ANPD SCCs must now be incorporated in transfer contracts (old DPA language doesn't suffice)
Notes transparency/documentation duties around transfers (RoPA, notice to data subjects)
Practical advice: audit existing intercompany agreements for ANPD SCC incorporation; don't rely on consent as a transfer workhorse
